detail.longDescription:
Running out of storage space?

Whether your camera roll is packed with similar selfies, your email inbox is overflowing, or large videos are slowing down your device, Cleaner makes phone maintenance fast, easy, and secure. With just a few taps, you can analyze your storage and sweep away the digital clutter you no longer need.

Features:

•Duplicate Photo & Video Cleaner: Instantly scan your gallery to identify and delete duplicate or similar photos, burst shots, and redundant videos. Keep your best memories and trash the rest.

•Large Video Remover: Quickly find and sort the heaviest videos taking up precious gigabytes on your phone so you can easily delete them.

•Powerful File Compression: Want to keep your files but save space? Compress large files and media directly on your device without losing quality.

•Custom Charging Animations: Add a personal touch to your device! Swap out the boring default battery screen for sleek, custom charging animations.

Stop deleting the apps you love just to take a new photo. Download Cleaner: Storage Cleaner today and give your iPhone the breathing room it deserves!
